command_necessity_policy.baseline_rule: The semantic-core seed and every exact fixed contract shell must pass together. A passing baseline proves all excluded mixed/certificate candidates unnecessary as a group for this frozen contract set.
command_necessity_policy.fixed_point_rule: Optional diagnostic: apply single-occurrence deletion in reverse source order until stable; production does not claim command minimality.
command_necessity_policy.necessity_rule: For each retained core command occurrence, remove it and rerun the exact Isabelle gate. PASS means REMOVE, semantic/elaboration FAIL means KEEP, and timeout or infrastructure failure means UNRESOLVED.
command_necessity_policy.production_acceptance_rule: Accept the proof-syntax-free deterministic semantic core when all mixed/certificate candidates are absent and all exact contract shells clean-build; record command_minimality_claimed=false.
command_necessity_policy.retained_command_effects: A retained command is trusted verbatim. Its exported facts and automation effects are legal semantic-substrate effects and are quantified later; they are not generated proof output.

completion_criteria.partial_campaign: any unsealed required theory or RED required contract produces only a partial report
completion_criteria.refine: all selected contracts are generated, assembled, sealed, and clean-built from frozen parents plus the sealed Semantic Base and sealed generated predecessors

contract_selection_policy.rule: select the fixed operation-style corres/connect contracts used by the existing Refine experiment

experimental_claim: Erase the ordinary Refine contract/helper proof layer and regenerate the selected contracts and supporting theorems over a command-level semantic substrate. Commands whose removal breaks the exact contract semantic/elaboration gate are retained verbatim; their residual human-certified proof power is disclosed and measured.

forbidden_path_policy.runtime_rule: raw Refine sources are readable only by trusted environment preparation; model and proof modules receive fixed contract packages, legal premise records, and the sealed Semantic Base heap

allow: declarations and disclosed facts exported by necessity-retained Semantic Base commands
deny: ordinary human-written contract/helper theorem facts removed from the Refine target scope
ordinary human-written Refine automation registrations outside retained semantic commands

model_backends.role: Session Planner, File Planner, Graph Revision Agent
Lemma Prover whole-proof generation and local salvage baseline

runner_state_policy.interrupted_red_recovery: Recover only checker-bound RED attempts whose source contains the active graph statement, dependency statements, and candidate proof.
runner_state_policy.mutation_lock: Serialize init, plan-file, run-file, and full run-session traversal with one non-blocking run-level lock because all theories share the canonical Session Planner ledger.
runner_state_policy.retry_feedback_recovery: Revalidate an unconsumed RETRY_PROOF against the active graph and consume it in exactly one subsequent logical round.

pilot.purpose: re-run the existing generated KHeap_R workload without ordinary human Refine theorem facts and measure which prior successes depended on removed proof-layer knowledge

source_scope.erase_theorems_from: the ordinary contract/helper proof layer of all theories owned by the Refine target scope

success_gate: the deterministic semantic-core selection is complete and its exact contract-shell baseline is GREEN
the Semantic Base clean-builds and all exact contract shells elaborate
every selected Refine contract is Isabelle-green
every required Refine theory is assembled and sealed from legal inputs

allowed_source_classes: necessity-retained Semantic Base commands and their disclosed exports
forbidden_source_classes: ordinary human-written Refine theorem and automation facts outside the retained command-level semantic substrate
